mapper.insert: INSERT INTO schedule ( trainno, depplacename, arrplacename, depplandtime, arrplandtime, booking_open_at, first_price, standard_price, status ) VALUES ( #{trainno}, #{depNodeId}, #{arrNodeId}, #{depTime}, #{arrTime}, #{bookingOpenAt}, #{firstPrice}, #{standardPrice}, 'SCHEDULED' )

INSERT INTO seat (schedule_seq, car_no, seat_no, seat_grade, status, version) VALUES
(#{scheduleSeq}, #{seat.carNo}, #{seat.seatNo}, #{seat.seatGrade}, 'AVAILABLE', 0)
ON CONFLICT (schedule_seq, car_no, seat_no) DO NOTHING
